recentItems.title: US-India Army Flex: Robot Dogs, Sniper, Dramatic 'Breach' Video| Watch 'Yudh Abhyas' Action In Auli
recentItems.description:
US and Indian Army troops showcase their combat capabilities during Exercise Yudh Abhyas 2026 in Auli, Uttarakhand. Around 600 personnel took part in the joint drill, featuring intense building-clearance and room-intervention exercises. Drones, robotic dogs, canines and snipers supported the counterterrorism training, highlighting tactical coordination, combat readiness and interoperability between the two armies.
